001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.path.IPath;
005import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.StringWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.List;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
020import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
021import org.slf4j.Logger;
022import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
023
024/**
025 * XML Filter Command Class
026 *
027 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from XML using TreePath expressions. Unlike
028 * XmlNavigateCommand which applies transformations, XmlFilterCommand only extracts/filters elements
029 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
030 *
031 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact XML
032 * structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for complex
033 * path expressions including nested elements and attributes
034 */
035public class XmlFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
036  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlFilterCommand.class);
037
038  private final IPath<List<String>> xpath;
039
040  /**
041   * Constructor for XML filtering with typed TreePath selector.
042   *
043   * @param xpath the typed TreePath to extract elements
044   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null
045   */
046  private XmlFilterCommand(IPath<List<String>> xpath) {
047    this.xpath = xpath;
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Factory method for XML filtering with typed path selector.
052   *
053   * @param xpath the typed path to extract elements
054   * @return an XmlFilterCommand instance
055   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null
056   */
057  public static XmlFilterCommand create(IPath<List<String>> xpath) {
058    if (xpath == null) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
060    }
061    return new XmlFilterCommand(xpath);
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
066    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
067
068      XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
069
070      XMLEventReader reader;
071      try {
072        reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
073      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
074        throw new IOException("Error creating XML reader: " + e.getMessage(), e);
075      }
076
077      try {
078        List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
079        boolean isCapturing = false;
080        int captureDepth = 0;
081        int currentDepth = 0;
082        String firstExtractedElement = null;
083        boolean isWrappedOutput = false;
084
085        CaptureSession captureSession = new CaptureSession(XMLOutputFactory.newInstance());
086
087        while (reader.hasNext()) {
088          XMLEvent event = reader.nextEvent();
089
090          if (event.isStartElement()) {
091            currentDepth++;
092            String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
093            currentPath.add(elementName);
094
095            // Check if this element matches our target path
096            if (xpath.matches(currentPath) && !isCapturing) {
097              isCapturing = true;
098              captureDepth = currentDepth;
099              try {
100                captureSession.start(event);
101              } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
102                isCapturing = false;
103                captureDepth = 0;
104                captureSession.abort();
105                throw new IOException("Error writing start element", e);
106              }
107            } else if (isCapturing && currentDepth > captureDepth) {
108              // We're inside a matching element, continue capturing with the same writer
109              try {
110                captureSession.add(event);
111              } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
112                isCapturing = false;
113                captureDepth = 0;
114                captureSession.abort();
115                throw new IOException("Error writing nested start element", e);
116              }
117            }
118
119          } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
120            if (isCapturing) {
121              try {
122                captureSession.add(event);
123              } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
124                isCapturing = false;
125                captureDepth = 0;
126                captureSession.abort();
127                throw new IOException("Error writing end element", e);
128              }
129
130              // If we're closing the captured element (re-check isCapturing in case catch reset it)
131              if (isCapturing && currentDepth == captureDepth) {
132                String extractedElement = captureSession.finish();
133                if (isWrappedOutput) {
134                  writer.write(extractedElement);
135                  writer.flush();
136                } else if (firstExtractedElement == null) {
137                  firstExtractedElement = extractedElement;
138                } else {
139                  writeWrappedOutputStart(writer, firstExtractedElement);
140                  isWrappedOutput = true;
141                  firstExtractedElement = null;
142                  writer.write(extractedElement);
143                  writer.flush();
144                }
145                isCapturing = false;
146                captureDepth = 0;
147              }
148            }
149
150            currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
151            currentDepth--;
152
153          } else if (isCapturing) {
154            // Characters, comments, etc. inside captured element
155            try {
156              captureSession.add(event);
157            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
158              isCapturing = false;
159              captureDepth = 0;
160              captureSession.abort();
161              throw new IOException("Error writing XML content", e);
162            }
163          }
164        }
165
166        // Ensure writer is closed if capture was interrupted
167        if (captureSession.isOpen()) {
168          captureSession.abort();
169        }
170
171        writeRemainingOutput(writer, firstExtractedElement, isWrappedOutput);
172
173      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
174        throw new IOException("Error processing XML: " + e.getMessage(), e);
175      } finally {
176        try {
177          reader.close();
178        } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
179          LOGGER.warn("Error closing XML reader: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
180        }
181      }
182    }
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Write extracted XML elements to the output writer
187   *
188   * @param writer the output writer
189   * @param elements list of extracted XML elements
190   * @throws IOException if writing fails
191   */
192  private void writeWrappedOutputStart(Writer writer, String firstElement) throws IOException {
193    writer.write("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>");
194    writer.write("<filtered-results>");
195    writer.write(firstElement);
196  }
197
198  private void writeRemainingOutput(
199      Writer writer, String firstExtractedElement, boolean isWrappedOutput) throws IOException {
200    if (firstExtractedElement != null) {
201      writer.write(firstExtractedElement);
202    }
203    if (isWrappedOutput) {
204      writer.write("</filtered-results>");
205    }
206    writer.flush();
207  }
208
209  private static final class CaptureSession {
210    private final XMLOutputFactory outputFactory;
211
212    private StringWriter elementWriter = new StringWriter();
213    private XMLEventWriter eventWriter;
214    private boolean open;
215
216    private CaptureSession(XMLOutputFactory outputFactory) {
217      this.outputFactory = outputFactory;
218    }
219
220    private void start(XMLEvent startEvent) throws XMLStreamException {
221      elementWriter = new StringWriter();
222      eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
223      open = true;
224      eventWriter.add(startEvent);
225    }
226
227    private void add(XMLEvent event) throws XMLStreamException {
228      if (open) {
229        eventWriter.add(event);
230      }
231    }
232
233    private String finish() {
234      abort();
235      return elementWriter.toString();
236    }
237
238    private void abort() {
239      if (!open) {
240        return;
241      }
242      try {
243        eventWriter.close();
244      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
245        LOGGER.warn("Error closing event writer: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
246      } finally {
247        open = false;
248      }
249    }
250
251    private boolean isOpen() {
252      return open;
253    }
254  }
255}
